'''Clue scroll (beginner)''' is an [[emote clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (beginner)|beginner]] [[Treasure Trails]].

==Clue info==
{{Clue info
|text=Panic at Al Kharid mine.
|notes=[[Al Kharid mine]] is located just north of [[Al Kharid]]. The area is quite large, so the step can also be completed at the southern entrance of the mine or standing in the north-western corner outside the mine.
|map={{Map|3298,3293|mtype=pin|plane=0|mapID=-1}}}}

==Transportation==
*[[Ring of the elements]] teleport to the [[Fire Altar]].
*[[Ring of dueling]] teleport to [[Emir's Arena]].
*[[Senntisten Teleport]] then trigger at the north-west corner outside the mine.
*[[Amulet of glory]] to [[Al Kharid]].
*[[Chronicle]] and run east to the north-west corner of the mine.
*[[Lumbridge Teleport]] or [[Lumbridge Home Teleport]] and go east to [[Al Kharid]] then north to the mine.
